newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: TURNOVER EBBS, BUT SLIGHT RISE SEEN.
newsitem.headline: TURNOVER EBBS, BUT SLIGHT RISE SEEN.

text.p: * Official list shares ease 0.16 points to 880.31 points.
* Group A shares advance 19.89 points to 1899.82 points.
* Central market turnover slackens to 297,000 litas from
* Block trades turnover slips to 100,000 litas from 285,000
litas.
* Brokers expect little change in prices this week but
perhaps a small regaining of ground in turnover.
Turnover on the central market of Lithuania's stock exchange ebbed to 297,000 litas from 390,000 litas Monday, and brokers said they expected little change except a slight increase in turnover.
"I don't expect major changes this week," said Aurimas Rishka, a broker with Litimpeks.
But dealers said they anticipated turnover to increase simply because volumes and prices are so low now.
Block trades turnover slipped to 100,000 litas from 285,000 litas.
Official list shares eased 0.16 points to 880.31 points, and group A shares advanced 19.89 points to 1899.82 points.
Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company (LISCO) rose to 6.49 litas from 6.42 litas and was the most active on the central market, turning over 69,000 litas.
"I think it will be around 6.45 litas to 6.55 litas this week," one dealer said.
Baltic Shipyard edged up slightly to 7.96 litas from 7.95 litas amid central market turnover of 55,000 litas.
"They have not been doing so well this year and performed poorly last year, but it's a company with potential in the long run," said one dealer.
Another company brokers say has long-term potential, despite present short-comings, is Lithuanian Gas, which advanced to 1.70 litas from 1.62 litas, although on a tiny turnover of only 680 litas.
Brokers also said that investors would remain keen on Hermis Bank, which has posted impressive results.
Despite its turnover of only 1,850 litas on the central market, Hermis shares continued their advance, rising to 185.00 litas from 182.00 litas.
"I think it will be around 185.00 litas to 190.00 litas this week," said one dealer.
-- Burton Frierson, Vilnius newsroom + 370 2 22 35 18
